excerpt: If you're already using the OpenAI SDK, point it at Requesty and you're done. No SDK changes, no new client to learn.
Fallback Policies automatically retry your requests with different models if one fails, ensuring your application stays reliable even when individual providers have issues.
Your request goes to the primary model first. If it fails (timeout, rate limit, error, etc.), the router immediately tries the next model in the chain.
Load Balancing Policies distribute your requests across multiple models based on weights you define. Perfect for A/B testing, gradual rollouts, and resource optimization.
Requests with the same trace_id or user_id always go to the same model.
Requesty's auto caching automatically caches long system prompts and repeated content to reduce costs on any provider that supports prompt caching.
Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK) allows you to use your personal API keys from various providers with Requesty.
The MCP (Model Context Protocol) Gateway enables AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Roo Code to securely connect to MCP servers through Requesty's unified API
Guardrails scan AI request content for sensitive information before it reaches a model provider.
Requesty's analytics dashboard gives you complete visibility into your AI usage across all models and providers. Track costs, requests, tokens, cache savings, and latency, all in real-time.
Route your AI traffic through Requesty's EU infrastructure in Frankfurt, Germany (AWS eu-central-1). All processing and storage by Requesty stays in the EU.
Using the Requesty integration, you can: Use 300+ models while coding, giving you flexibility to choose the best model for each task.
Requesty makes every supported model speak structured JSON — from simple json_object mode to strict, schema-enforced json_schema mode.
No per-seat pricing, no minimum spend. You pay for what your application spends, plus 5%.
Access 600+ models through one API with intelligent routing, real-time analytics and centralized governance.
